summary_en: This phase 2 study tests pirtobrutinib, a BTK inhibitor, in adults aged 75 and older with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). Pirtobrutinib is taken by mouth once a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and cycles repeat every 28 days if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is a phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa pirtobrutinib, un inhibidor de BTK, en adultos de 75 años o más con leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC). El pirtobrutinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Men or women aged 75 years or older
Diagnosis of CLL or small lymphocytic lymphoma per 2018 iwCLL criteria
No prior treatment for CLL, with listed exceptions
Needs treatment according to 2018 iwCLL guidelines
ECOG performance status of 3 or less
not_for: Recent serious heart problems, such as class III or IV heart failure, unstable angina, or heart attack within 3 months
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
